DATELINE: 18 July 2026 (Saturday) — nominations closed Friday 17 July, field published.

REPORTED CONTENT:
- Nigel Farage faces a record field of 33 opponents (34 candidates in total) in the Clacton
  by-election, triggered by his own resignation earlier this month.
- Tendring District Council said the field of 34 is believed to be the largest ever assembled
  for a UK parliamentary election.
- Previous record understood to be 26 candidates at the Haltemprice and Howden by-election,
  July 2008.
- Ballot paper includes three candidates from the Official Monster Raving Loony Party, several
  minor parties and a large number of independents.
- Better-known challengers include political satirist Count Binface and Reclaim Party leader
  Laurence Fox.
- Polling day: Thursday 13 August 2026.

NOTE: The morning edition already carried "33 candidates". The refinement here is 34 candidates
TOTAL (i.e. Farage + 33 opponents), the council attribution, and the 2008 Haltemprice comparison.
